description: Bitcoin Ordinals inscription activity for the last N blocks (1-144, default 6) from the UniSat Open API: total inscription events (new inscriptions plus transfers of existing ones), events per block and per hour, and a sample of the latest events. Requires UNISAT_API_KEY. Related tools on this server, for a different need: crypto_btc_blocks_range when you need up to 144 consecutive Bitcoin blocks descending; crypto_btc_chain_tips when you need recent stale/orphaned Bitcoin blocks and sidechain forks. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

blocks.description: Number of recent blocks to analyze
